sources: the registered caps in the instrument

proposal_to_the_pi.if_no: the clustering step should be reported as retired rather than left in artifacts that look like results, and the pool-relative limitation stays as the honest ceiling on the neighbour claim
proposal_to_the_pi.if_yes: option A at pool 1,023 fits the conservative reading at 19 of 24 operations per item and is the cheapest version that could plausibly separate; it costs 456 conservative operations for a 24-item run and 24,576 rows under the per-row reading
proposal_to_the_pi.single_question: is the feature-pool claim worth buying? It is the only claim in MP-E12a that the current budget cannot support against the real donor, and it is the one the plan's superposition risk names.
proposal_to_the_pi.what_i_will_not_do: pick one. Choosing the parameter that makes the instrument produce a story is the failure this whole ledger exists to prevent.

status: LIMITATION REGISTERED WITH A PROPOSAL. Nothing here is applied: the pool rule and K_NEIGHBOURS stand as registered, the sealed class-1 graph is untouched, and no extraction was run to tune any of it.

also_true_of_the_synthetic_calibration.meaning: the degeneracy is not a property of the real donor. It appeared on random matrices too, which is how it was known to be about the instrument before this step had any real result to blame.

the_finding_as_measured.consequence_for_the_sealed_graph: the pool_clusters field in the sealed class-1 artifact carries no information beyond k. The edges and cosines are unaffected -- they come from the similarity search, not from the linking -- so the sealed figures stand and only this one derived field is empty of content.
the_finding_as_measured.what: the mutual-nearest-neighbour feature-pool step returned exactly ONE component for every item, and that component had exactly K_NEIGHBOURS members
the_finding_as_measured.why_it_happens: clustering runs over the k neighbours already read, so with k=10 the graph has 10 nodes and mutual linking over a 63-row pool connects them densely enough that they land in one component every time. A step that can only return one component at every item is not measuring structure; it is echoing k.

A_pool_large_enough_for_k_to_bind.proposal: raise the candidate pool so that 10 neighbours are sparse in it and mutual linking can actually separate
A_pool_large_enough_for_k_to_bind.risk: a bigger pool makes the neighbour claim stronger and the clustering claim weaker at the same time: with more candidates, one component of 10 stops being evidence of a pool and starts being evidence of nothing in particular unless k also moves
A_pool_large_enough_for_k_to_bind.the_wall: a global search over all 50,257 rows is 787 read calls per item: 789 conservative operations against a budget of 24, and 16,384 rows is where the instrument's own MAX_READS_PER_PROBE cap binds first
A_pool_large_enough_for_k_to_bind.what_it_would_change: the pool-relative caveat in every sealed artifact would loosen, and the 17 deferred words would still be deferred

B_k_as_a_fraction_of_the_pool.and_the_other_problem: k=10 is registered in the plan's instrument description and appears in the sealed calibration's schema. Changing it makes new graphs non-comparable with the sealed ones unless the change is versioned, which is why this is a proposal and not an edit.
B_k_as_a_fraction_of_the_pool.proposal: set k = max(2, round(pool / f)) for a registered fraction f, so the neighbour count scales with the pool instead of being an absolute constant
B_k_as_a_fraction_of_the_pool.the_problem_this_one_has: f cannot be chosen by measurement without running an extraction to see which f separates. That is tuning the instrument on results, which is the same act as raising a cap after seeing the need, only earlier in the chain. f has to be fixed by argument before the next read.
B_k_as_a_fraction_of_the_pool.what_it_costs: no extra reads at all -- the pool is unchanged, so the conservative cost stays at 4 operations per item and 96 for the run. The cost is in the graph: fewer edges per item, and every sealed edge count changes meaning

what_may_not_happen.no_cap_raised_here: MAX_ROWS_PER_READ, MAX_READS_PER_PROBE, READ_BUDGET_OPS and POOL_CAP are unchanged by this file. Nothing in the cost table was obtained by editing them.
what_may_not_happen.no_choice_after_a_result: neither A nor B may be picked by looking at what a pilot run returns. The PI chooses on the argument, or the program runs a registered pilot whose purpose and cost are written down first -- and that pilot is an extraction, so it needs authorising.
what_may_not_happen.no_sealed_artifact_rewritten: the class-1 graph keeps its pool_clusters field exactly as it was emitted, empty of information or not
